title: The Sigil of Ironhollow Again
author: Marguerite Hartwell
blurb: Edmund Kavanagh, a bone-carver who hears the dead, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
